criteria.text: The participant has cytologically or histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic HPV associated malignancies or MSS small bowel or colorectal cancer
The participant has cytologically or histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic HPV associated malignancies or MSS small bowel or colorectal cancer

The participant has cervical cancer, P16+ oropharyngeal cancer, anal cancer, vulvar cancer, vaginal cancer, penile cancer, squamous cell rectal cancer, or another locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor that is known HPV+
The participant has received two prior lines of systemic chemotherapy
The participant has received one prior line of systemic chemotherapy and checkpoint therapy if it is FDA approved for their specific tumor type
Prior checkpoint therapy is not required if it is not FDA approved for the participant's specific tumor type
The participant is not eligible to receive the above therapies or declines these standard treatment options after appropriate counseling
The participant has measurable disease per RECIST 1.1
The participant is at least 18 years old
The participant has an ECOG performance status of 2 or less
The participant has adequate hematologic function at screening: ANC >= 1.5 x 10^9/L, hemoglobin >= 9 g/dL, and platelets >= 100,000/microliter

The participant has adequate renal and hepatic function at screening: creatinine clearance > 50 mL/min, bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN (or <= 3.0 x ULN with Gilbert's syndrome), and ALT/AST <= 2.5 x ULN (or <= 3 x ULN with liver metastases)
The participant agrees to use highly effective contraception at study entry and for a specified period after the last dose of study drugs
If the participant is serologically positive for HIV, Hep B, or Hep C, their viral loads are undetectable by quantitative PCR

If the participant is HIV positive, they have a CD4 count >= 200 cells/mm3, are on stable antiretroviral therapy for at least 4 weeks, and have no reported opportunistic infections or Castleman's disease within 12 months prior to enrollment
The participant is able to understand and is willing to sign a written informed consent document

The participant has not received prior investigational drug, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or any prior radiotherapy (except palliative bone directed therapy) within the past 28 days prior to enrollment, unless the investigator has assessed that all residual treatment-related toxicities have resolved or are at grade 1 severity and the participant is otherwise suitable for enrollment
The participant has not received a live vaccine within 30 days prior to enrollment
The participant has not undergone major surgery within 28 days prior to enrollment

The participant does not have known active brain or central nervous system metastasis (less than a month out from definitive radiotherapy or surgery), seizures requiring anticonvulsant treatment (<3 months), or clinically significant cerebrovascular accident (<3 months). If they have CNS disease, it must not have progressed at least a month after definitive treatment, they must be on <=10 mg of prednisone, and any intratumoral or peritumoral hemorrhage must be grade <= 1 and stable on two consecutive imaging scans

The participant is not on systemic intravenous or oral corticosteroid therapy (except hormone replacement or physiologic doses <= 10 mg/day prednisone equivalent) or other immunosuppressive drugs such as azathioprine or cyclosporin A. If they were on these treatments, they must be discontinued at least 1 week prior to enrollment for recent short course use (<= 14 days) or at least 4 weeks prior to enrollment for long term use (> 14 days). The use of corticosteroids as premedication for contrast-enhanced studies is allowed prior to enrollment and on study

The participant does not have a history of serious intercurrent chronic or acute illness, such as cardiac or pulmonary disease, hepatic disease, bleeding diathesis, or recent (within 3 months before enrollment) clinically significant bleeding events, or other illness or medical condition considered by the Investigator as high risk for investigational drug treatment. For participants otherwise eligible to be assigned to receive just PDS01ADC and entinostat (without bintrafusp alfa, Arm 3), bleeding diathesis or recent bleeding will not be an exclusion
The participant is unwilling to accept blood products as medically indicated

The participant does not have conditions associated with significant necrosis of nontumor-bearing tissues, such as esophageal or gastroduodenal ulcers < 3 months prior to enrollment, organ infarction < 3 months prior to enrollment, or active ischemic bowel disease
The participant does not have medically significant third space fluid, such as symptomatic pericardial effusion, ascites, or pleural effusion requiring repetitive paracentesis

The participant does not have a history of second malignancy within 3 years of enrollment, except for adequately treated localized skin cancer, cervical carcinoma in situ, superficial bladder cancer, or other localized malignancy which has been adequately treated or malignancy which does not require active systemic treatment (e.g. low risk chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL))

The participant does not have a known severe hypersensitivity reaction to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to any of study drugs (grade >/= 3 NCI-CTCAE v5), or if they do, they will be evaluated by the allergy/immunology team prior to enrollment
The participant is not pregnant and is not nursing

P1.text: Phase I: Subjects with cytologically or histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic HPV associated malignancies or MSS small bowel or colorectal cancer (Cohort 1).

P2.text: Phase II: Subjects with cytologically or histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic HPV associated malignancies (Cohort 2), or MSS small bowel or colorectal cancer (Cohort 3).

P4.text: Subjects with MSS colorectal or small bowel cancer must have received two prior lines of systemic chemotherapy.

P5.text: Subjects with HPV associated malignancies must have received one prior line of systemic chemotherapy as well as checkpoint therapy if checkpoint therapy is FDA approved for that specific tumor type (e.g., HNSCC and PDL1+ cervical cancer).

P6.text: Prior checkpoint therapy is not needed where checkpoint therapy has not been FDA approved for that specific tumor type (e.g., anal, vaginal, vulvar, penile, PDL1 negative cervical).

P7.text: Exceptions to the above include participant who are not eligible to receive the above therapies or who decline these standard treatment options after appropriate counseling has been provided.

P8.text: Subjects must have measurable disease, per RECIST 1.1.

P12.text:
Adequate renal and hepatic function at screening, as follows:

  * Measured or calculated creatinine clearance (using the Cockcroft-Gault equation) \> 50 mL/min
  * Bilirubin \<= 1.5 x ULN OR in subjects with Gilbert s syndrome, a total bilirubin \<= 3.0 x ULN
  * Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) \<= 2.5 x ULN, unless liver metastases are present, then values must be \<= 3 x ULN).

P13.text: The effects of the immunotherapies on the developing human fetus are unknown. For this reason and because immunotherapeutic agents as well as other therapeutic agents used in this trial are known to be teratogenic, individuals of child-bearing potential and those who can father children must agree to use highly effective contraception (hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence) at the study entry and for 4 months after the last bintrafusp alfa dose, 3 months after the last entinostat dose and 2 months after the last PDS01ADC dose, whichever occurs later.

P14.text: Participants serologically positive for HIV, Hep B, Hep C are eligible as long as the viral loads are undetectable by quantitative PCR.

P15.text: HIV positive participants must have CD4 count \>= 200 cells per cubic millimeter at enrollment, be on stable antiretroviral therapy for at least 4 weeks and have no reported opportunistic infections or Castleman's disease within 12 months prior to enrollment.

P16.text: Subjects must be able to understand and be willing to sign a written informed consent document.

P17.text: Participants with prior investigational drug, chemotherapy, immunotherapy or any prior radiotherapy (except for palliative bone directed therapy) within the past 28 days prior to enrollment except if the investigator has assessed that all residual treatment-related toxicities have resolved or are at grade 1 severity and feel the participant is otherwise suitable for enrollment.

P18.text: Administration of live vaccine within 30 days prior to enrollment

P19.text: Major surgery within 28 days prior to enrollment (minimally invasive procedures such as diagnostic biopsies are permitted).

P20.text: Known active brain or central nervous system metastasis (less than a month out from definitive radiotherapy or surgery), seizures requiring anticonvulsant treatment (\<3 months) or clinically significant cerebrovascular accident (\<3 months). In order to be eligible participants must have repeat CNS imaging at least a month after definitive treatment showing CNS disease that has not progressed. Participants with CNS disease that has not progressed at least a month after definitive treatment and continued on \<=10 mg of prednisone (or equivalent) for treatment of brain or central nervous system metastasis are eligible to enroll in this study. Participants with evidence of intratumoral or peritumoral hemorrhage on baseline imaging are also excluded unless the hemorrhage is grade \<= 1 and has been shown to be stable on two consecutive imaging scans.

P21.text: Subjects on systemic intravenous or oral corticosteroid therapy with the exception of hormone replacement or physiologic doses of corticosteroids (\<= the equivalent of prednisone 10 mg/day) or other immunosuppressive drugs such as azathioprine or cyclosporin A are excluded on the basis of potential immune suppression. For these subjects these excluded treatments must be discontinued at least 1 weeks prior to enrollment for recent short course use (\<= 14 days) or discontinued at least 4 weeks prior to enrollment for long term use (\> 14 days). In addition, the use of corticosteroids as premedication for contrast-enhanced studies is allowed prior to enrollment and on study.

P22.text: Subjects with a history of serious intercurrent chronic or acute illness, such as cardiac or pulmonary disease, hepatic disease, bleeding diathesis or recent (within 3 months before enrollment) clinically significant bleeding events, or other illness or medical condition considered by the Investigator as high risk for investigational drug treatment. Note: For participants otherwise eligible to be assigned to receive just PDS01ADC and entinostat (without bintrafusp alfa, Arm 3), bleeding diathesis or recent bleeding will not be an exclusion.

P23.text: Subjects unwilling to accept blood products as medically indicated.

P24.text: Subjects with conditions associated with significant necrosis of nontumor-bearing tissues: esophageal or gastroduodenal ulcers \< 3 months prior to enrollment, organ infarction \< 3 months prior to enrollment, or active ischemic bowel disease.

P25.text: Presence of medically significant third space fluid (symptomatic pericardial effusion, ascites or pleural effusion requiring repetitive paracentesis).

P26.text:
History of second malignancy within 3 years of enrollment except for the following: adequately treated localized skin cancer, cervical carcinoma in situ, superficial bladder cancer, or other localized malignancy which has been adequately treated or malignancy

which does not require active systemic treatment (e.g. low risk chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL)).

P27.text: Subjects with a known severe hypersensitivity reaction to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to any of study drugs (grade \>/= 3 NCI-CTCAE v5) will be evaluated by the allergy/immunology team prior to enrollment.

P28.text: Pregnant individuals are excluded from this study because these drugs have not been tested in pregnant individuals and there is potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects. Because there is an unknown but potential risk for adverse events in nursing infants secondary to treatment of the mother with these immunotherapies, nursing should be discontinued if the mother is treated on this protocol.

rule.registry: Known active brain or central nervous system metastasis (less than a month out from definitive radiotherapy or surgery), seizures requiring anticonvulsant treatment (\<3 months) or clinically significant cerebrovascular accident (\<3 months). In order to be eligible participants must have repeat CNS imaging at least a month after definitive treatment showing CNS disease that has not progressed. Participants with CNS disease that has not progressed at least a month after definitive treatment and continued on \<=10 mg of prednisone (or equivalent) for treatment of brain or central nervous system metastasis are eligible to enroll in this study. Participants with evidence of intratumoral or peritumoral hemorrhage on baseline imaging are also excluded unless the hemorrhage is grade \<= 1 and has been shown to be stable on two consecutive imaging scans.
